Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MSFT.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1727 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2022.
Our gross margin expanded by 188 basis points to 59.7%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.75 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Revenue guidance of $43.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
